system.ssh.title: Personal SSH connection
system.ssh.description: Read the current caller SSH grant and machine addresses. Same-host clients use local files; Admin enablement is separate.
system.ssh.returns: Connection · state, host, port, username, authentication, home, addresses
errors: Not enabled, unavailable or SSH management not configured.

system.users.title: User profiles
system.users.description: List registered user profiles available for ownership assignment.

components.assign_owner.title: Attribute shared software
components.assign_owner.description: Set the responsible user or built-in attribution for Loom-supplied software. Sharing, namespace, source revisions and Job pins remain unchanged. Reserved system attribution requires installation administrator access for both assignment and restoration. Runtime uses namespace host; software namespaces/pins and execution permissions remain preserved. System resources remain discoverable through MCP and are hidden from Dashboard discovery. Changing registry responsibility requires the author/current responsible owner or authenticated installation administrator; attribution cannot be used to acquire lifecycle management rights.
components.assign_owner.returns: Attribution · kind, id, namespace, owner_profile, owner_kind, changed
errors: Unregistered user, missing extension, read-only scope or maintenance fence.

jobs.assign_owner.title: Assign Job owner
jobs.assign_owner.description: Set the current responsible user, preserving original execution and submitter records.
errors: Unregistered profile or missing Job.

results.assign_owner.title: Assign result owner
results.assign_owner.description: Set the current responsible user for a model, dataset or artifact.
errors: Unregistered profile or missing artifact.

jobs.queue.title: Shared execution order
jobs.queue.description: Read every user's waiting order and available controls.
jobs.queue.returns: Queue · revision, entries with position, held, reason, capabilities

jobs.reorder.title: Reorder waiting Job
jobs.reorder.description: Move a waiting Job; a logical workflow moves its remaining waiting nodes as one group. Preserve running Jobs and dependencies.
errors: Permission denied, invalid position or reference no longer waiting. If execution was claimed first, changed=false.

jobs.hold.title: Hold waiting Job
jobs.hold.description: Prevent new stages of a waiting Job. Active preparation finishes, but run cannot start.
errors: Permission denied. If the main run already started, changed=false.

jobs.resume.title: Resume waiting Job
jobs.resume.description: Release an ordinary hold while preserving order. This is not error recovery or checkpoint restart.
errors: Permission denied. Releasing a failed Job's hold does not rerun its failed execution.

system.guide.title: Loom guides
system.guide.description: Read server version and guide index, or a document by id. Matching known_revision returns not_modified.
errors: Unknown document ID or invalid arguments.

jobs.list.title: List Jobs
jobs.list.description: List logical Jobs in reverse registration order. include_consolidated=true also returns preserved constituent Jobs.
jobs.list.returns: Job[] · id, status, state, owner, attempt, recovery, category, execution_mode

jobs.get.title: Job details
jobs.get.description: Read state, Attempts, internal_steps, consolidation provenance, work_timeline from original execution receipts, waiting reasons, recovery, callbacks and artifacts. Consolidated work elapsed time includes sources; Attempts retain continuation runtime timestamps. family adds bounded Main Job, prerequisite/follow-up and real execution-node navigation with original states and Runtime pins; presentation grouping does not change execution membership or completion.
jobs.get.returns: Job · status, scheduling, recovery, attempts, stages, callbacks, result
errors: The ID does not exist.

jobs.submit.title: Submit Job
jobs.submit.description: Pin a registered profile and parameters and enter the queue. category does not select the executor. One requested outcome is one Job; batch/vectorized work runs internally. Explicit consolidates reuses completed producer Jobs without rewriting them.
errors: Unregistered profile, parameter schema mismatch, denied input access or stopped admission.
Reusing a key with different execution content causes a conflict.

jobs.cancel.title: Cancel Job
jobs.cancel.description: Cancel the specified Job, regardless of owner. For active execution, verify actual resource return separately.
errors: Missing cancel scope.

jobs.logs.title: Execution logs
jobs.logs.description: Read Attempt logs using a byte cursor. Continue from next_offset.
jobs.logs.returns: Log range · available, offset, next_offset, text
errors: Attempt belongs to another Job, negative offset or limit outside 1–65536.

recovery.claim.title: Claim recovery
recovery.claim.description: Claim a failed Job awaiting a response. Pass the returned lease to progress/resume.
recovery.claim.returns: Recovery · state, rounds, agent, deadline, hard_deadline, lease
errors: Waiting deadline expired or another agent already claimed recovery.

recovery.progress.title: Report recovery progress
recovery.progress.description: Report progress with a valid lease to refresh the idle deadline, without extending the round's hard deadline.
recovery.progress.returns: Recovery · state, rounds, agent, deadline, hard_deadline
errors: Lease mismatch, claimant mismatch or expired recovery deadline.

recovery.resume.title: Rerun after repair
recovery.resume.description: Schedule recovery at the reserved queue position using a valid lease. Inspect the live patch schema; finalization-only repair preserves the successful execution Attempt.
errors: Lease mismatch, three recovery rounds exhausted or invalid patched inputs.
For finalization-only failure, retry postprocessing without a patch.

recovery.defer.title: Defer recovery
recovery.defer.description: Release the current queue reservation. Dependent Jobs wait while independent Jobs proceed.
errors: No valid reservation. Another user's reservation can be explicitly released; the acting user is recorded.

recovery.reactivate.title: Reactivate deferred Job
recovery.reactivate.description: Return a deferred Job to a new queue position without resetting recovery rounds.
errors: Job is not deferred.

events.list.title: Completion and error events
events.list.description: Read up to 100 unacknowledged recipient events in seq order. Use kind=all to include completion.
events.list.returns: Event[] · seq, job, code, kind, ack, delivery_state
errors: Unsupported kind or invalid cursor.

events.ack.title: Acknowledge event
events.ack.description: Record receipt of an event. This does not claim recovery or mark work complete.
errors: Event belongs to another recipient or seq does not exist.

components.list.title: List components
components.list.description: Read the latest revision of all components. Set owner to filter the namespace. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.
components.list.returns: Component[] · owner (namespace), id, revision, owner_profile, owner_name, owner_kind

components.get.title: Component details
components.get.description: Read an exact or latest Job lifecycle Component manifest and profiles.
components.get.returns: Component · owner namespace, id, revision, manifest, profiles and current attribution
errors: Missing Component revision or read scope.

components.write.title: Write source
components.write.description: Save editable source at a relative path. Active revisions remain unchanged.
components.write.returns: Editable source receipt · owner, id, path, bytes

example.content:
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
r = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[-1]).read_text())
o = Path(r["output_dir"])
(o/"sample.txt").write_text("hello")
p = {"profile": r["profile"]["revision"], "producer_sha256": r["profile"]["sha256"]}
(o/"result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"entities": [{"id": "sample", "kind": "artifact", "path": "sample.txt", "provenance": p, "relations": []}], "metrics": []}))

errors: Invalid identity, unsafe relative path, missing submit scope or inactive installation.

components.register.title: Register revision
components.register.description: Register source as an immutable revision. profiles is optional; standalone register_profile can reference the revision. New orchestration defaults to Rust; discover Cargo/SDK templates with components.scaffold. Registration never builds or executes source.
components.register.returns: Registration · owner (namespace), id, revision, profiles[], owner_profile, owner_name, owner_kind
errors: Missing source, unavailable runtime, missing GPU permission or profile contract mismatch.

components.register_profile.title: Register profile
components.register_profile.description: Register an execution Profile combining optional Component, exact Tools and stage environments. Optional multi-purpose usage is descriptive. Available without redeployment; Jobs pin the revision.
components.register_profile.returns: Profile receipt · owner, id, revision, kind, sha256
errors: Uncached image, resource limit exceeded, unregistered component or invalid schema.
components.register_profile.example_note: The exact Runtime must contain the shown prebuilt Rust executable, and the referenced Component must already exist. Replace these placeholders; for @producer builds follow the authoring guide and verified receipt workflow.

components.get_profile.title: Profile details
components.get_profile.description: Read a specific or latest revision of an independently registered profile.
components.get_profile.returns: Profile · owner namespace, id, revision, profile
errors: Missing Profile revision or read scope.

components.profiles.title: Available execution profiles
components.profiles.description: Read exact Profile combinations, stage environments and observed Job usage. Repeated environment dependencies are a bounded preview (dependency_count, dependencies_complete); use components.get_runtime for the complete inventory. Read scope does not grant execution or registration rights. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.
components.profiles.returns: Profile[] · kind, revision, params_schema, outputs, limits, usage, combination

results.list.title: List artifacts
results.list.description: Discover native artifacts and imported models/datasets/experiments from the active catalog. For record_type=historical, pass history_ref to results.historical; other entries use results.get. Discovery does not establish file availability. Labels use current presentation curation; results.historical retains the recorded source name.
results.list.returns: Artifact list · native registry entries or historical entries with history_ref and detail_action

results.get.title: Artifact details
results.get.description: Read an artifact record by exact ID and revision. Template-backed scientific records include current typed research_summary, robot and metadata_status. Additive operator normalization exposes metadata_provenance with the source digest, evidence and reason; original manifest fields and execution remain preserved.
results.get.returns: Registry entity with current display label, immutable manifest fields, registered locations and optional template metadata/provenance
errors: Missing artifact revision or read scope.

results.reindex.title: Reindex results
results.reindex.description: Retry publication for a returned execution without restarting GPU execution. Published output identities, hashes, metadata and lineage must remain identical; use reconnect to add a verified location.
errors: Not the current Attempt or publication cannot be retried in this state.

results.reconnect.title: Reconnect artifact location
results.reconnect.description: Register a verified replacement location for an existing immutable artifact component. Does not rerun execution or change artifact contents.
results.reconnect.returns: Location receipt · id, revision, component, ref, status=available
errors: Requires submit scope; unknown store/component, unsafe path or mismatched size/hash is rejected.

results.annotate.title: Add annotation
results.annotate.description: Append an immutable evidence-backed note to an existing Job; the id is a Job ID, not an artifact ID. Existing results are preserved.
errors: Requires submit scope.

results.history.title: Preserved history
results.history.description: Read all preserved records with pagination.
errors: Requires read scope.

results.historical.title: Historical record
results.historical.description: Read immutable history plus current registered-copy availability. Recorded missing does not prove the original was deleted.
results.historical.returns: Historical record · body, source identity and current_availability (not_connected, missing, verified, present_unverified, mismatch or unavailable)
errors: The specified record does not exist.

system.updates.title: Release check status
system.updates.description: Compare cached GitHub Releases with the current build. Reads do not wait on network requests or the Job database.
system.updates.returns: ReleaseCheck · status, installed, latest, update_available, checked_at, last_success_at, next_check_at, error, stale

system.check_updates.title: Check for releases
system.check_updates.description: Request a background check respecting the 60-second cooldown and GitHub rate limits. Does not install releases or stop Jobs.
errors: Failures appear in updates.error while preserving the last successful result.

system.status.title: Service status
system.status.description: Read build, contract revision, admission, registered runtimes and GPU execution availability.
system.status.returns: Status · build, api_revision, admission, inventory, runtime_ids, gpu_execution_enabled

system.docker.title: Container status
system.docker.description: Read permitted Docker containers and observation status.
system.docker.returns: Docker status · status, engine, containers, errors
errors: Missing or stale observations are reported through status and errors.

system.contract.title: Job contract
system.contract.description: Read Job properties, public states, recovery policy and submission schema.

system.describe.title: Action reference
system.describe.description: Omit group/action for the full reference; supply group for that group reference, or group and action for one exact action schema and example.
system.describe.returns: Documentation index or Action reference · schema, scope, returns, errors, examples
errors: Unknown action or action outside current scopes.

components.curate.title: Curate Runtimes workspace metadata
components.curate.description: Set a Profile display name, purpose, preferred/archive state or declared Tool stage roles; set representative dependencies on an exact Runtime. Does not rewrite execution definitions or select a Runtime. Legacy state changes use the same lifecycle overlay, owner/admin authorization, Built-in protection and audit. Prefer inspect_lifecycle/set_lifecycle for an explicit preview and atomic batch.
errors: Submit scope, maintenance fence, exact identity, dependency scope or preference conflict.

components.inspect_profile.title: Inspect a reusable Profile
components.inspect_profile.description: Read stage Runtime evidence and scoped dependency requirements; optionally validate parameters. Does not reserve resources, install, import code or submit a Job.
components.inspect_profile.returns: Inspection, parameter validation and partial submission draft
errors: Unknown Profile or invalid inspection arguments.

components.compare_profiles.title: Compare exact Profile definitions
components.compare_profiles.description: Compare source, stage, Tool/Runtime, parameter and output contracts. Returns changed paths without environment variable values. Display-only changes do not count as execution changes.
errors: Unknown Profile.

components.annotate.title: Classify software
components.annotate.description: Attach evidence-backed revision tags and a concise label without changing source, digests, Profiles or Jobs.

example.evidence: Verified planner interface in this revision.

errors: Missing revision, invalid tag, submit scope denied or maintenance fence.

components.runtimes.title: List Runtimes
components.runtimes.description: Read administrator-granted execution environments, exact dependencies, validation evidence and Profile/Job usage. Legacy entries are not verification evidence. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.

components.dependencies.title: Dependencies
components.dependencies.description: Read major software units grouped across current granted Runtimes, with exact versions, distinct installation origins and Runtime links. Full transitive package inventories remain on each Runtime. This is recorded metadata, not filesystem discovery or proof of scientific use.

components.get_dependency.title: Dependency versions
components.get_dependency.description: Read all recorded versions and origins of one dependency across granted Runtime revisions, including history.
errors: Dependency unavailable or outside instance grant.

components.get_runtime.title: Runtime revision
components.get_runtime.description: Read one exact immutable Runtime revision and its consumers. Installation/build is an explicit host-administrator workflow. job_usage links frozen stage pins to source Jobs and their Main Job; execution_receipts distinguishes started stages from unexecuted bindings. At most 200 Job rows are returned with jobs_complete.
errors: Missing revision or instance grant.

components.list_tools.title: List research Tools
components.list_tools.description: List shared reusable software independently of Job Components. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.

components.get_tool.title: Tool revision
components.get_tool.description: Read an exact or latest immutable software revision.
errors: Missing Tool revision.

components.register_tool.title: Register research Tool
components.register_tool.description: Register source or explicitly copy an exact legacy Component revision; existing Jobs and revisions remain unchanged. New orchestration defaults to Rust; discover Cargo/SDK templates with components.scaffold. Registration never builds or executes source.
errors: Invalid source, missing legacy revision or denied submit scope.

jobs.submit_workflow.title: Submit one logical Job
jobs.submit_workflow.description: Atomically submit pinned internal execution nodes with node dependencies and output aliases. Each node uses the ordinary scheduler and verified artifacts. Replay the exact request key after an uncertain response.
jobs.submit_workflow.returns: Logical Job ID and node execution IDs
errors: Unknown/cyclic node dependency, conflicting key, invalid Profile or output alias. All nodes roll back on rejection.

jobs.curate.title: Curate research presentation
jobs.curate.description: Preview or apply additive, evidence-backed presentation bindings. Original execution, timestamps, results and software revisions remain intact. Omit dry_run for a preview; false applies the exact batch once. User-requested Runtime preparation and diagnostics remain user work; test/System is reserved for platform checks. parent_job groups the same requested outcome across follow-ups without changing scheduler dependencies or Runtime pins.
errors: Unknown identity, repeated item, parent cycle, conflicting batch key, maintenance or scope denied.

results.search_items.title: Search Items
results.search_items.description: Search registered metadata and verified bounded text with exact/prefix/lexical ranking, current/all revisions, origin/relation filters and optional bounded at_least watermark waits. scenario_ref also matches active exact context links, including linked preserved snapshots; context changes expire those cursors. task_id groups every revision of one Task; use scenario_ref for one exact revision and never supply both. A bounded content page can be empty with a non-null next_cursor; follow it to inspect later candidates. include_system defaults to true for API/MCP discovery; false excludes current System responsibility before pagination, including files inherited from a System parent. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.
results.search_items.returns: Search page · items, next_cursor, partial, consistency, warnings
errors: Index unavailable, invalid/expired cursor, changed source/access or unsupported search.

results.get_item.title: Read Item
results.get_item.description: Read a compact typed descriptor using a decimal-string Item ID and optional exact revision. Display labels use current curation even when an exact revision is selected; immutable source pins remain unchanged.
results.get_item.returns: Item descriptor · item_id, revision_id, kind, label, native_ref and kind-specific metadata
errors: Invalid Item ID or missing/deleted source revision. File Items also require their canonical inventory and index.

results.resolve_item.title: Resolve native reference
results.resolve_item.description: Resolve an already adopted full native identity without allocation, promotion or latest-snapshot substitution.
errors: The exact native reference has not been adopted, or its source was deleted.

results.item_relations.title: Read Item relations
results.item_relations.description: Page exact outgoing declarations and indexed reverse software use. Cursors pin source revision, authority head, actor and index generation; unresolved references remain explicit.
results.item_relations.returns: Relation page · items, next_cursor, partial, warnings
errors: Missing source revision or expired cursor; incoming relations require a source-qualified index.

results.item_files.title: List Item files
results.item_files.description: Page the sealed registered file inventory for an exact Item revision; File IDs survive derived index rebuilds.
results.item_files.returns: File search page · items, next_cursor, partial, consistency, warnings
errors: Missing owner revision, unavailable index/inventory or expired cursor.

results.get_file.title: Read File descriptor
results.get_file.description: Read recorded digest, exact owner revision and currently registered candidate copies.
results.get_file.returns: File · item_id, revision_id, parent_item_id, owner_revision_id, path, size, sha256, copies
errors: Unknown File, unavailable index/canonical inventory or changed sealed metadata.

results.read_file.title: Read registered bytes
results.read_file.description: Read at most 262144 verified bytes; offsets are decimal strings and returned data_base64 preserves raw bytes.
results.read_file.returns: File range · file_item_id, offset, next_offset, total_bytes, data_base64, eof, verification
errors: No granted readable copy, pending verification, changed bytes or invalid offset.

jobs.log_streams.title: List log streams
jobs.log_streams.description: Discover exact Attempt/stage/effect streams for an existing Job without creating work or acknowledging notifications.
jobs.log_streams.returns: Stream page · items, next_after, partial, warnings
errors: Unknown Job or unavailable exact stream metadata.

jobs.read_log.title: Read log range
jobs.read_log.description: Read raw byte ranges or bounded tail. Keep source_generation with offsets; report closed, gap and unavailable states.
jobs.read_log.returns: Log range · stream_id, source_generation, raw offsets, data_base64, text, eof, closed, gap
errors: Unknown stream, changed source generation, expired retention or unavailable raw bytes.

jobs.search_logs.title: Search log ranges
jobs.search_logs.description: Find indexed text within a Job or exact stream. Page the pinned index snapshot and follow raw offset references.
jobs.search_logs.returns: Log search page · items with raw offset references, next_cursor, partial, consistency, warnings
errors: Query too broad, unavailable index/source, expired cursor or retained-byte gap.

system.dashboard_summary.title: Read Dashboard summary
system.dashboard_summary.description: Read compact Item counts and index capabilities; does not expand file or log inventories.
system.dashboard_summary.returns: Summary · schema, counts by kind, search, capabilities, observed_at

system.search_status.title: Read search status
system.search_status.description: Read safe generation/checkpoint and partial coverage status without filesystem paths or private diagnostic content.
system.search_status.returns: Index status · status, catalog_head, backfill/adoption/inventory counts; generation and indexed_through when available

results.reconcile_contract.title: Discover reconciliation
results.reconcile_contract.description: Read accepted source adapters, explicit operations, scopes and limits.
results.reconcile_contract.returns: Contract · accepted asset adapters, operations, size/count limits and validation scope

results.reconcile_inspect.title: Inspect registered reconciliation scope
results.reconcile_inspect.description: Page registered metadata without scanning unregistered payload directories.
results.reconcile_inspect.returns: Registered metadata page · items, next_cursor, partial, warnings, scope, scan_performed=false
errors: Index unavailable, invalid filter or expired cursor.

results.reconcile_plan.title: Plan an exact reconciliation
results.reconcile_plan.description: Normalize a bounded explicit proposal with a stable key; reject ambiguous or conflicting identities. This does not copy files or create research execution.
results.reconcile_plan.returns: Plan · plan_id, state, normalized proposal, validation and optional original receipt
errors: Unknown source contract, conflicting source identity/key or proposal bound exceeded.

results.reconcile_get.title: Read reconciliation receipt
results.reconcile_get.description: Read the caller’s durable proposal, validation state and original apply receipt.
results.reconcile_get.returns: Plan · plan_id, state, proposal, created, validation summary, receipt
errors: Plan missing or owned by another actor.

results.reconcile_validate.title: Validate reconciliation sources
results.reconcile_validate.description: Hash only declared candidates off the execution writer, check grants and original evidence, and record proofs. Validation is structural and byte-integrity only.
results.reconcile_validate.returns: Plan with passed validation summary · file count, bytes and verification time
errors: Plan context/source changed, inaccessible candidate, mismatched digest/size or another actor’s plan.

results.reconcile_apply.title: Apply verified reconciliation
results.reconcile_apply.description: Recheck source stamps, exact identities and grants, then atomically add imports or bindings. Historical originals and Job/Attempt counts are preserved.
results.reconcile_apply.returns: Applied plan receipt with original operation outcomes; exact replay returns that receipt
errors: Validation required, stale contract/source/grant, changed bytes or conflicting import/binding.

system.rebuild_search.title: Rebuild search online
system.rebuild_search.description: Build a separate source-qualified generation while the current index stays readable; switch atomically after catch-up.
system.rebuild_search.returns: Maintenance task · id, kind, state, progress, receipt, error
errors: Changed request under the same key, another pending rebuild or incompatible roots.

system.catalog_task.title: Read maintenance progress
system.catalog_task.description: Read caller-scoped durable background maintenance progress, failure or receipt.
system.catalog_task.returns: Caller-owned maintenance task · id, kind, state, progress, receipt, error
errors: Task missing or owned by another actor.

jobs.prune_logs.title: Expire selected log generations
jobs.prune_logs.description: Expire explicit returned and closed stream generations, preserve gap evidence and remove their searchable/raw captured bytes. Does not remove Jobs or containers.
jobs.prune_logs.returns: Retention maintenance task · id, kind, state, progress, receipt, error
errors: Live/unreturned source, unknown generation, unavailable raw bytes or changed request key.

system.dashboard_page.title: Page Dashboard records
system.dashboard_page.description: Project only selected metadata records into browser DTOs using the same filters and cursor as item search. Returns compact task_refs and research_tasks independently of the bootstrap. scenario_ref selects accepted pins or active exact typed links. task_id groups every revision of one Task; use scenario_ref for one exact revision and never supply both. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.
system.dashboard_page.returns: Browser catalog page · entities, research_tasks, next_cursor, partial, consistency and shared catalog metadata
errors: Unavailable index/source, incompatible filters or expired cursor.

system.dashboard_activity.title: Dashboard activity
system.dashboard_activity.description: Read a compact KST activity rollup from actual execution intervals and eligible registration times; no full catalog expansion.
system.dashboard_activity.returns: Activity · timezone, through, coverage and daily Job/asset counts with execution durations
errors: Unsupported view or unavailable source state.

system.dashboard_entity.title: Dashboard entity
system.dashboard_entity.description: Read one exact source-qualified browser record with lazy file inventories.
system.dashboard_entity.returns: Exact browser catalog projection including selected entities and common Item/revision IDs
errors: Missing Item/source revision or unavailable canonical metadata.

system.prune_search.title: Prune retired search generations
system.prune_search.description: Remove at most eight retired private shadow generations older than ten minutes. Preserve active generation and all authority.
system.prune_search.returns: Cleanup maintenance task · id, kind, state, progress, receipt, error
errors: Changed request under the same key or incompatible catalog roots.

system.retry_catalog_task.title: Retry failed catalog maintenance
system.retry_catalog_task.description: Resume a failed task with retained progress and unchanged configured roots. An exhausted original batch budget requires a new rebuild request.
system.retry_catalog_task.returns: Maintenance task with retained progress and state=pending
errors: Task missing/not failed, changed roots or another pending rebuild.

components.scaffold.title: Scaffold a producer
components.scaffold.description: Return the selected Rust Tool/Component/hybrid source draft and vendored SDK. Runtime and external SDK placeholders require selection; this neither builds nor registers software.
components.scaffold.returns: files, manifest, draft_profile, producer_protocol and build_executed=false
errors: Invalid package name.

components.validate_package.title: Validate a source package
components.validate_package.description: Check source paths, bounds and declared Python integration metadata. This performs no compilation, import or installation.
errors: Escaping/conflicting paths, empty source, oversized package or undeclared Python integration.

results.scenarios.title: List Research Tasks
results.scenarios.description: List versioned research task/protocol contexts. Archived Research Tasks are omitted unless requested.
results.scenarios.returns: Research Task summaries with current revision

results.get_scenario.title: Read a Research Task
results.get_scenario.description: Read an exact Research Task revision, or the current revision when omitted. Archive state does not erase accepted context.
results.get_scenario.returns: Research Task definition, revision and digest
errors: Unknown Scenario or revision.

results.scenario_graph.title: Read Research Task links
results.scenario_graph.description: Page explicit links for a Research Task revision; links describe context and do not schedule execution.
errors: Unknown Scenario revision.

results.register_scenario.title: Create a Research Task
results.register_scenario.description: Create a versioned task/protocol definition with a nonempty label. Replay the same key and definition after uncertainty.
errors: Invalid definition, changed request key or inactive installation.

results.update_scenario.title: Revise a Research Task
results.update_scenario.description: Append a definition revision using expected_revision and a reason. Existing Job/context pins retain their accepted revision.
errors: Stale expected_revision, archived Scenario or key conflict.

results.archive_scenario.title: Archive a Research Task
results.archive_scenario.description: Remove a Research Task from default discovery using an expected current revision. Exact accepted references remain valid.
errors: Stale revision or key conflict.

results.link_scenario.title: Link Research Task context
results.link_scenario.description: Add an explicit typed relationship to an exact existing target with provenance. Does not infer context, duplicate output or grant access.
errors: Unknown target/context or conflicting key.

results.supersede_scenario_link.title: Supersede a context link
results.supersede_scenario_link.description: Append a supersession receipt for a link, optionally naming an existing replacement. Original link evidence remains.
errors: Unknown link/replacement or key conflict.

results.bind_historical_location.title: Bind a historical copy
results.bind_historical_location.description: Verify size, SHA-256 and granted store-relative locator, then add current availability to an exact historical file selector. Original history stays unchanged.
errors: Unknown historical selector, conflicting original hash, changed bytes or unavailable grant.

results.refresh_metadata.title: Persist recovered research metadata
results.refresh_metadata.description: Preview or persist verified scientific browse facts for one exact existing entity/historical revision. The original manifest/body is preserved. Apply requires the preview source digest and a stable request key; unavailable fields are not fabricated.
results.refresh_metadata.returns: Metadata receipt · target, source_sha256, facts, inputs, dry_run, stored
errors: Source changed, no recoverable metadata, unsupported target, maintenance fence or missing submit scope.
results.refresh_metadata.example_note: Preview first. Apply with dry_run=false, key and expected_source_sha256 from that preview.

results.link_dataset.title: Link an existing derived Dataset
results.link_dataset.description: Preview and add an exact, acyclic Dataset parent with a typed transformation and registered component evidence. Original records remain immutable; member-level semantic claims remain producer/operator evidence.
results.link_dataset.returns: Lineage preview/receipt · digest, dry_run, stored, exact source-bound claim
errors: Missing/non-Dataset revision, unregistered evidence hash, self/cyclic relation, or changed preview digest.

results.organize_dataset.title: Organize an existing Dataset
results.organize_dataset.description: Preview or apply source-bound browsing context under an already linked exact Task and a stable subgroup path. This does not declare data derivation or rewrite source records.
errors: Exact Dataset or linked Task missing; conflicting subgroup label; source or current assignment changed; maintenance fence.
results.organize_dataset.example_note: Preview first, then apply with expected_digest, a stable key and dry_run=false.

results.metadata_templates.title: List metadata templates
results.metadata_templates.description: List current immutable output metadata formats; include_revisions exposes previous revisions. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.
errors: Unknown or mismatched template, invalid schema or typed metadata, changed source/revision, maintenance fence or insufficient scope.
results.metadata_templates.example_note: Resolve the real template and use its returned sha256; the illustrative digest is a placeholder. Adoption applies only with the preview expected_digest, dry_run=false and a stable key.

results.get_metadata_template.title: Read a metadata template
results.get_metadata_template.description: Read an exact schema, bounded display fields and content digest. Omitting revision explicitly selects the current revision.
results.get_metadata_template.returns: Template · id, revision, sha256, output_kind, definition
errors: Unknown or mismatched template, invalid schema or typed metadata, changed source/revision, maintenance fence or insufficient scope.
results.get_metadata_template.example_note: Resolve the real template and use its returned sha256; the illustrative digest is a placeholder. Adoption applies only with the preview expected_digest, dry_run=false and a stable key.

results.register_metadata_template.title: Register a metadata template revision
results.register_metadata_template.description: Register or revise a shared format derived from an exact base. Extensions cannot weaken standard fields or replace their display meaning.
results.register_metadata_template.returns: Registered template · exact revision and hash
errors: Unknown or mismatched template, invalid schema or typed metadata, changed source/revision, maintenance fence or insufficient scope.
results.register_metadata_template.example_note: Resolve the real template and use its returned sha256; the illustrative digest is a placeholder. Adoption applies only with the preview expected_digest, dry_run=false and a stable key.

results.validate_metadata.title: Validate output metadata
results.validate_metadata.description: Validate a draft against an exact template kind, schema and display field types. Structural validation is not scientific acceptance.
errors: Unknown or mismatched template, invalid schema or typed metadata, changed source/revision, maintenance fence or insufficient scope.
results.validate_metadata.example_note: Resolve the real template and use its returned sha256; the illustrative digest is a placeholder. Adoption applies only with the preview expected_digest, dry_run=false and a stable key.

results.adopt_metadata.title: Normalize existing output metadata
results.adopt_metadata.description: Preview and apply an additive operator-declared normalization for an exact existing source. Retain originals and reject changed source or prior annotation. Evidence and the comparable format reference remain provenance; no scientific verification is invented.
results.adopt_metadata.returns: Adoption · target, source_sha256, expected_digest, template_ref, summary, stored, previous_annotation

example.reason: Normalize only supported fields from the recorded source

errors: Unknown or mismatched template, invalid schema or typed metadata, changed source/revision, maintenance fence or insufficient scope.
results.adopt_metadata.example_note: Resolve the real template and use its returned sha256; the illustrative digest is a placeholder. Adoption applies only with the preview expected_digest, dry_run=false and a stable key.

results.report_contracts.title: List report contracts
results.report_contracts.description: Page registered immutable reporting templates; default requirements can be adapted with exact evidence before Job submission. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.
results.report_contracts.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.get_report_contract.title: Read report contract
results.get_report_contract.description: Read exact coverage, schemas, display descriptors, semantic pins and evidence-backed adaptations.
results.get_report_contract.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.register_report_contract.title: Register report contract
results.register_report_contract.description: Register a new shared analysis contract or immutable revision. A base can be adapted with source-bound evidence; new required analysis needs definitions and reporter support.
results.register_report_contract.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.validate_report_contract.title: Validate report contract
results.validate_report_contract.description: Preview normalized effective coverage without registration or execution. Validates schemas, semantic references and adaptation evidence.
results.validate_report_contract.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.report_definitions.title: List reporting definitions
results.report_definitions.description: Page registered metric, factor and evaluation protocol definitions. Lifecycle metadata is additive. MCP discovery includes archived revisions by default; include_archived=false hides archived entries, and lifecycle_state selects an exact state before pagination. Dashboard defaults to hiding archived registrations.
results.report_definitions.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.get_report_definition.title: Read reporting definition
results.get_report_definition.description: Read an exact metric, factor or protocol definition; semantic meaning and units remain pinned.
results.get_report_definition.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.register_report_definition.title: Register reporting definition
results.register_report_definition.description: Register a metric with units/population/reduction, an SDG factor or a task-specific protocol with an exact primary metric and success predicate.
results.register_report_definition.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.read_report.title: Read verified report fields
results.read_report.description: Read a report bound to an exact output revision and requirement. JSON pointers select a field; arrays are paged. Bytes are SHA-256 verified and responses are bounded to 256 KiB.
results.read_report.returns: Exact reporting resource, validated coverage or bounded verified report page
errors: Missing or changed evidence, invalid coverage, schema/population mismatch, conflicting revision/key, denied scope, or unavailable report bytes.

results.get_report_evidence.title: Read adaptation source evidence
results.get_report_evidence.description: Read a bounded JSON subtree and exact source-body SHA-256 from an immutable artifact, historical record or registered software revision. Use the returned object as adaptation evidence; no database access or digest reconstruction is required.
results.get_report_evidence.returns: Exact target, source SHA-256, JSON pointer and value (maximum 64 KiB)
errors: Missing or inexact source, absent pointer, denied read scope, or evidence subtree larger than 64 KiB.

components.inspect_lifecycle.title: Preview registry lifecycle
components.inspect_lifecycle.description: Inspect exact registrations, current lifecycle, management rights, registered reverse references and dependencies and recorded Job usage. Returns a digest for atomic apply. Related registrations are never selected automatically. Built-ins are protected; file contents are not scanned.
components.inspect_lifecycle.returns: Preview · targets, related, related_count, related_truncated, jobs, job_count, jobs_truncated, desired_state, reference_coverage, cascade, digest
errors: Stale preview or changed references: 409. Missing exact revision: 404. Unauthorized or Built-in: 403.

components.set_lifecycle.title: Archive or restore registrations
components.set_lifecycle.description: Set active, deprecated or archived for explicit exact targets after inspect_lifecycle. Only author/current responsible owner or authenticated installation admin may manage; Built-ins are protected. Revalidates the preview and applies the entire batch atomically with audit and idempotent receipt. Preserves files, sealed definitions, accepted pins and running/past Jobs. No automatic cascade or physical deletion.
errors: Stale preview or changed references: 409. Missing exact revision: 404. Unauthorized or Built-in: 403.
